latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Network Security Audit Platform.
- Enables comprehensive network security assessments across 12 critical security domains.
- Generates detailed audit reports with scores, critical findings, remediation recommendations, and compliance mapping (NIST-CSF, CIS, ISO 27001).
- Provides endpoints for health checks, security audits, domain documentation, and supported compliance frameworks.
- Supports multi-user workflows with session tracking and audit accountability.
- Offers tiered pricing plans, including a free tier for limited usage.
